GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (5 Jun 46) GA
(SCAPIN - 1000)
APO 500
5 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of German Nationals.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 370.05 (23 Feb 46)GA, (SCAPIN -769), 23 February 1946, subject: "Repatriation of German Nationals and Nationals who claim Austrian or Czechoslovakian Citizenship now in Japan".
2. Information submitted in compliance with above reference was deficient as indicated by inclosures attached hereto and described as follows:
a. Incomplete statements outlining reasons for not desiring repatriation (Incl #1).
b. No statements outlining reasons for not desiring repatriation (Incl #2).
c. German nationals known to be in Japan but whose names do not appear on lists submitted (Incl #3).
d. German military and naval personnel for whom no German addresses were submitted (Incl #4).
3. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government submit to General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers not later than 20 June 1946 information listed as being deficient in paragraph 2 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
4 Incls: As identified above.
